name: The Back Room
tagline: Pizzeria by day, something else by night
description: Your team runs a pizzeria in the mall: dough, three sauces, toppings from shrimp to pineapple, the oven, drinks from the tap, customers at the counter. From midnight to eight the shop is shut and the cellar works: order supplies on the wall screen, grow and shred, pour the liquids into the mixer by the recipe book, pack the packets in the carry box. By day the box goes upstairs for the buyers. When the screen says the police are a minute away, the box goes back down the lift.
